title: Phase 6 收口 75-case microbench 的 Pareto 分解

headline.same_runtime_caveat: samples=5 under ABBA gives 3 qjs-first vs 2 zjs-first; the order is unbalanced so this figure is corroborating evidence only, not a headline

counterfactual_equal_startup.method: subtract the 208 us startup delta from every zjs total, leave execution untouched

ordering_c_verdict: startupAdjustedGeometricMean (1.5297) divides by a payload that is near zero or negative for 52 of 75 cases; weak_map_set reaches 10.106. The metric is arithmetically unusable at this suite composition and must not be quoted.

startup/bootstrap.note: No case in the suite nominally targets startup, so this cluster holds no cases. It is instead a suite-wide constant of 208 us per invocation, and it is the whole measurement for the 52 cases listed in startup_dominated_cases.

pareto.basis: startup folded into one synthetic item; every other item is the payload delta of a payload-resolving case
